create_version: create a Version object from a string like '1.2.3' with optional experiments dict
test_version_comparison: test Version objects for equality, less-than, and greater-than comparisons
build_version_match: build a wildcard version match check against a Version object
list_all_versions: list all valid dataset version directories on disk sorted by version
review_version_class: review the Version class and its comparison, hashing, and matching methods
